_comment_panel: Top-level panel settings. Copy this file to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored.

panel._comment_jwtSecret: Long random string. Override via JWT_SECRET in .env if you prefer.
panel._comment_sessionTtl: How long a login lasts, in seconds. 12h default.

_comment_auth: Local username/password auth. Password is a bcrypt hash. Use scripts/hash-password.js to generate one.
_comment_activityLog: Activity log database. SQLite if better-sqlite3 builds for your platform, otherwise JSON.
_comment_polling: Polling cadence for stats and rcon status checks (ms).
_comment_servers: Server connection details live in servers.json (gitignored). See servers.example.json.
